title: Malaysian-Italian Chicken Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful soup that combines the spices of Malaysia with the heartiness of Italian cooking.

ingredients.name: soup vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, celery, and onions

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the Malaysian chili paste and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth, soup vegetables, and chicken breast to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped arugula and cook for another minute, until wilted.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional arugula if desired.
